what: Copy Number Variant Inference from Single-Cell ATAC Sequencing
title: Copy Number Variant Inference from Single-Cell ATAC Sequencing
text: Copy number variant inference single-cell ATAC sequencing, without matched normal control. CopyscAT bins fragment counts across genome, corrects chromatin accessibility bias using CpG density, decomposes per-chromosome-arm signal Gaussian mixture models assign copy number states individual cells. also detects double minutes focal amplifications changepoint analysis, calls regions loss heterozygosity, separates neoplastic non-neoplastic cells non-negative matrix factorisation. fork spcdot/CopyscAT.

title: Copy Number Variant Inference from Single-Cell ATAC Sequencing
text: Several dependencies come Bioconductor best installed first: generateReferences() additionally needs BSgenome package genome, example BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("edogiuili/CopyscAT") # install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install(c("edgeR", "biomaRt", "rtracklayer", "GenomicRanges"))

title: Copy Number Variant Inference from Single-Cell ATAC Sequencing
text: See vignette("copyscat") full workflow, including focal amplifications, LOH, using inferred normal cells baseline.
code: library(CopyscAT)  # Once per genome build and bin size. library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38) generateReferences(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, genomeText = "hg38",                    tileWidth = 1e6, outputDir = ".")  # Once per R session. initialiseEnvironment(   genomeFile   = "hg38_chrom_sizes.tsv",   cytobandFile = "hg38_1e+06_cytoband_densities_granges.tsv",   cpgFile      = "hg38_1e+06_cpg_densities.tsv",   binSize      = 1e6,   minFrags     = 1e4,   cellSuffix   = c("-1") ) setOutputFile(".", "samp_dataset")  # Normalise, collapse to chromosome arms, filter. scData          <- readInputTable("sample_matrix.tsv") scData_k_norm   <- normalizeMatrixN(scData, blacklistCutoff = 125,                                     dividingFactor = 1) scData_collapse <- collapseChrom3N(scData_k_norm, minimumChromValue = 100,                                    tssEnrich = 1, minCPG = 300) scData_collapse <- filterCells(scData_collapse, minimumSegments = 40,                                minDensity = 0.1)  # Call CNVs. median_iqr           <- computeCenters(scData_collapse) candidate_cnvs       <- identifyCNVClusters(scData_collapse, median_iqr) candidate_cnvs_clean <- clusterCNV(candidate_cnvs, candidate_cnvs[[3]],                                    minDiff = 1.5) final_cnv_list       <- annotateCNV4(candidate_cnvs_clean, saveOutput = TRUE,                                      outputSuffix = "clean_cnv")

title: CopyscAT 1.0.0
text: Restructuring release. Existing scripts continue work. CNV calls unchanged. verified installing v0.40 v1.0.0 side side running simulated dataset fixed seed: outputs collapseChrom3N(), filterCells(), computeCenters(), scaleMatrix(), identifyCNVClusters(), clusterCNV() annotateCNV4() numerically identical. Two outputs differ, v0.40 wrong: pos column normalizeMatrixN() now holds full coordinates. v0.40 split bin names non-alphanumeric character, position written scientific notation truncated exponent sign — 1e+06 became "1e", every bin chromosome collapsed handful labels. Downstream stages key chrom, CNV calls unaffected. Counts never altered. saveSummaryStats() reports accurate cell counts. verification run v0.40 reported finalFilterCells = 148 startingCellCount = 0 true values 147 150. versions produced 147-cell matrix; reported numbers wrong.

title: CopyscAT 1.0.0
text: Split single 2504-line cnv_caller_functions_packaged.R topical files (setup.R, normalize.R, collapse.R, cluster.R, annotate.R, loh.R, others). Moved 23 packages Depends Imports, loading CopyscAT longer attaches user’s search path. NAMESPACE now declares explicit imports instead relying attachment. Dropped Rtsne, FNN, igraph, zoo, limma sp, none used. Moved biomaRt, rtracklayer, GenomicRanges jsonlite Suggests. annotateLosses() generateReferences() now report clearly suggested package missing. Added .gitignore .Rbuildignore; untracked .DS_Store, .Rhistory stale duplicate source file.

title: CopyscAT 1.0.0
text: readInputTable() ignored sep argument always read tab-separated files. cutAverage() returned NA whenever input contained NA, despite computing quantiles na.rm = TRUE. filterCells() recorded pre-outlier-filter cell count finalFilterCells, saveSummaryStats() overstated surviving cells. two progress messages also reported denominator. collapseChrom3N() aborted argument length zero genomes without chrX chrY; sex inference now skipped message. collapseChrom3N() reassigned logTrans <- FALSE mid-function, making logTrans = TRUE branch unreachable. Sex inference keeps original untransformed behaviour via separate local variable. clusterCNV() called S4Vectors::isSorted(), available Bioconductor package happened attached. Replaced local helper. identifyCNVClusters() failed opaque sample() error subsetSize exceeded cell count; now clamped warning. mclust::mclustBIC imported, identifyCNVClusters() failed find function "mclustBIC" unless mclust attached. getAlteredSegments() hardcoded barcode suffix -1 instead using scCNVCaller$cellSuffix. graphics::segments() stats::.dendrogram() used without imported. normalizeMatrixN() split bin names unanchored separate(), truncated coordinates containing extra separators. PDF devices now closed .exit(), error mid-analysis longer leaves device open file truncated.

title: CopyscAT 1.0.0
text: initialiseEnvironment() setOutputFile() validate paths, bin sizes, trim quantiles barcode suffixes, warn CpG cytoband references describe different numbers bins. Functions need initialised session now say instead failing NULL lookup downstream. Conditions previously printed message returned NULL — every bin blacklisted, cell passing filter — now raise errors naming parameter adjust. annotateCNV4B() validates expectedNormals cluster assignments.

title: CopyscAT 1.0.0
text: Rewrote roxygen documentation: every parameter documented, @return sections added, functions grouped families reference index. Added copyscat vignette covering full workflow. Added pkgdown site configuration rewritten README. Added testthat suite 77 tests, including end--end integration tests verify simulated copy number gain recovered pipeline. Added GitHub Actions R CMD check (Linux/macOS/Windows), test coverage, linting pkgdown deployment. identifyCNVClusters() gained verbose argument; per-arm mixture summaries longer printed unconditionally.
